newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TENNIS-PANOVA STUNS COETZER IN KREMLIN CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PANOVA STUNS COETZER IN KREMLIN CUP.

text.p: Russia's Tatyana Panova ousted a player 191 places above her in the world rankings, South African Amanda Coetzer, in the first round of the Kremlin Cup women's tournament on Tuesday.
Third seed Coetzer, the world number 16, was beaten 6-4 6-4 by Panova, who joins compatriots Elena Makarova and Anna Kournikova in the second round.
Panova, world ranked 207, hit back after trailing 2-0 in the first set by winning five games in a row.
"I was not 100 percent confident of victory but simply played my own game," Panova said.
Number one seed Conchita Martinez trounced Austria's Sandra Dolfer 6-3 6-3.
The Spaniard moved to the top of the seedings after Steffi Graf was forced to pull through injury.
